Every citizen aged 18 years or above has the right to vote.

items: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 is a high-frequency question regarding the reduction of voting age in India.
Questions often contrast the previous voting age requirement (21 years) with the present voting age (18 years).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Universal Adult Franchise guarantees the right to vote to every citizen aged 18 years or above.
The voting age in India was previously 21 years.
The reduction of the voting age from 21 to 18 was brought about by the 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988.
